notes.title: Network Master - May Devlog
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

In this post, we would like to give you a glimpse of what awaits you in the next Update. In addition to a quite a few bug fixes, we focused on developing the network 🌐

[h3]Connecting cables to the server[/h3]

We will add switches and patch panels in servers, which will be necessary to connect a large number of computers to the network 🖥️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161644/84be896dcac5990690e2ba918415ffea8b1700ac.png[/img]

[h3]Connecting network devices[/h3]

In addition to configuring the network, devices need to be physically connected by cable. There will be routers and wall sockets to connect 🛜

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161644/8d2141ebd5c575284f14aa7626c2ca27b26d30a5.png[/img]

[h3]Building a physical network[/h3]

It is also necessary to run cables to different rooms, sockets and expand the physical network 🛠️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161644/fa0551844640e9b436ac0e387acfe085cf712ce5.png[/img]

[h3]New rooms[/h3]

We will also add new offices and rooms, specially prepared for these missions 🏢

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161644/7c45208554760ac92ffa5be4294715caede5041d.png[/img]

[h3]New items in the shop[/h3]

In order to perform missions you will need the right equipment, so we have added it to the shop. You will find there, for example, cables and routers 🛒

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161644/815af94c4766c369a34556e8c28ffdb25e2c7db5.png[/img]


We hope you enjoyed this teaser!
See you soon,
[i]ServiceIT Team[/i]
